_README: This is the COMPACT content spec a human authors. You write prose + base metric
magnitudes only; `python3 branches/_forge/kb_forge.py THIS.json -o OUT.kb.json`
computes every derived field (formulas, ids, priority_order, obligations) so the
dense gate passes by construction. The forge IGNORES this _README key.
DENSE-MODE COUNTS the gate requires (fill enough blocks to land in-band):
nodes 19-24 | edges 32-40 | conflict_axes 8-10 | edge_cases 10-12 |
workflow 9-12 | competency_questions 10-14 | dominance_rules 7-12 |
anti_rework_rules 7-12 | iteration_protocol 6-10.
RULES the FORGE enforces (it refuses with a precise message otherwise):
- node id is UPPER_SNAKE and unique.
- every base metric below is a number in [0,1]; uncertainty_interval is [lo,hi].
- node with risk_if_wrong >= 0.80  MUST have non-empty acceptance_tests.
- node with cross_topic_coupling >= 0.75  MUST have non-empty revisit_triggers.
- edge_type in {dependency,constraint,conflict,causal,sequence,feedback,similarity}.
- a 'conflict' edge MUST supply a resolution_rule.
- every edge from/to and every *_ref points at a real node id / CQ id.
RULES the GATE enforces afterward (the forge does NOT — keep them true yourself):
- dependencies form a DAG (no cycles); the dense kb_validator rejects cycles.
- the dense-mode COUNT bands above; every derived score must recompute.
Make 3 of these specs (3 KBs) to feed one specialist.
purpose: REPLACE one precise sentence: what an expert in this subdomain reasons about.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
exclusions: REPLACE what this KB deliberately does NOT cover

competency_questions.question: REPLACE — a question this KB must let an expert answer
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REPLACE what a good answer must contain

nodes.definition: REPLACE a dense one-paragraph definition of this unit of expert work.
failure_modes: REPLACE how this step goes wrong

base.update_signal: REPLACE what new evidence would change this unit

nodes.definition: REPLACE. If you set risk_if_wrong>=0.80 you MUST add acceptance_tests; if cross_topic_coupling>=0.75 you MUST add revisit_triggers.
acceptance_tests: REPLACE a check that proves this unit is done right
revisit_triggers: REPLACE a signal that this unit must be re-examined

edges.why_related: REPLACE why the second unit needs the first
REPLACE the tension between these two
edges.resolution_rule: REPLACE which one wins and under what condition

dominance_rules.rule: REPLACE when X and Y conflict, X wins

priority_rationale: REPLACE one line: why the foundational nodes precede the dependents.
